Zelensky:
I'm not crying when I see that the soldiers of Russia who are on our territory and killing our people are dying.
It's their choice. The choice of one person. The soldiers are not free, but they have their hands.
It's Putin's choice to push them onto other land.

Abdul El-Sayed:
People ask me, when you gave your victory speech, why did you choose to introduce yourself by your full name?
Because whether your name is Mike or your name is Donald or your name is whatever JD stands for, or your name is Abdul or your name is Abdulrahman, all of those are American names.
